hypothesis: RX softirq lands on only CPU2/CPU5 (bnx2 RSS is 2-tuple, 2 clients). With reuseport each named worker owns 1/8 of flows, so the workers sharing CPUs with softirq fall behind and their sockets overflow. A single shared socket lets idle workers pick up slack; expect higher QPS if imbalance is the limiter.

hypothesis: Nehalem E5530 has no PCID, so PTI (Meltdown) + retpoline/IBRS make every recvmsg/sendmsg syscall and IRQ expensive. named is CPU/syscall bound (Rcvbuf drops, no NIC/backlog drops), so mitigations=off should give a large gain (>15%).
label: best+mitigations-off
